description: A tiled hall of shower stalls under a ceiling that drips its own weather back on you. The heat is total and undeserved and, for about four credits' worth of nothing, entirely yours. Somewhere in the fog a man is singing, badly, and nobody has asked him to stop, because this is the one room in Coldwater where that would be cruelty.
name: Lather & Lye — The Baths
